title: Jammy Peruvian Katsuobushi Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Peruvian stew featuring katsuobushi, perfect for a cozy evening meal. This paleo-friendly dish is simmered to perfection in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Heat the earthenware bowl over medium heat on the stovetop.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced aji amarillo peppers and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the cubed sweet potatoes, chicken broth, and coconut milk, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and let cook for 20 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Stir in the katsuobushi and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the flavors have melded together and the stew has thickened slightly.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
